cases.name: 1080p-standard-half-false
cases.scope: One isolated off/on pair, three route repeats each; synthetic GPU/frame percentiles are not inferred
cases.percentileAggregation: Median of each repeat's percentile; not a pooled percentile
cases.gpuCaveat: Command-buffer busy means and overlapping pass spans are not exclusive costs or frame percentiles
cases.presentationCaveat: Requested unlocked/VSync-off settings do not prove unpaced presentation. The 120Hz flag is an interval/acquire heuristic; inspect CPU work, acquire waits and repeat variability separately.
cases.gpuFrameContract: First GPU start to last GPU end of buffers committed on the render thread inside each frame; includes gaps, never sums overlapping spans; pending/invalid/empty/overflow frames excluded and counted
